title: NEPA Match Night
tagline: 85th minute. Super Eagles level. Then the light goes.

text.default: The Super Eagles are level in the 85th minute and NEPA chooses this exact moment to strike. The whole compound screams. You and {rival} both know that whoever brings the match back will be hosting the viewing for the rest of the night.
text.team_2v2: The Super Eagles are level in the 85th minute and NEPA chooses this exact moment to strike. Two households, one dead street. You and {partner} want to be the ones who bring the match back, and {rival} are thinking the same.
text.coop: The Super Eagles are level in the 85th minute and NEPA chooses this exact moment to strike. The whole compound is screaming. You and {partner} have about a minute to get something running before the match is over.

stakes.default: Hosting the viewing for the rest of the night.
stakes.coop: Saving the match for the whole compound.

choices.label: Sweet-talk the neighbour with the generator
Run to the junction for fuel
Shout until the whole compound mobilises
Check if it is just your fuse

decisive.recap: {winner} gets a power source working. {loser} is now politely asking if there is space on the sofa.

both_succeed.recap: You both find power, so the compound splits into two rival viewing parties.

both_fail.recap: Nobody could get anything running, so the street is down to radio commentary.

tie.recap: The compound refuses to pick a side and votes for whoever has the bigger TV.

same.recap: You all went for the same idea at once and ended up fighting over one extension cord.

all_pass.recap: The lights flicker back and the whole compound roars.

mixed.recap: Power comes back on one side of the compound and the rest crowd round.

all_fail.recap: Nothing works and the compound is left with commentary on a phone.

text.default: Twenty people are crammed into a sitting room built for six, all staring at one screen. The best chair is empty for exactly one more second, and {rival} is already eyeing it.
text.team_2v2: Two households squeeze into one sitting room built for six. The best sofa is empty for exactly one more second, and {rival} are eyeing it too.
text.coop: Twenty people are crammed into a sitting room built for six, and everyone wants a good view. You and {partner} have to keep the peace and keep the picture.

stakes.default: The best chair and the remote.
stakes.coop: Keeping the room calm during the match.

choices.label: Offer drinks to win the best chair
Dive for the chair
Declare the chair reserved
Take the spot with the best view of the screen

decisive.recap: {winner} sinks into the best chair while {loser} ends up on the floor behind a pillar.

both_succeed.recap: You both find good seats, though {winner} gets the one with the cushion.

both_fail.recap: You all end up standing at the back with a view of someone's head.

tie.recap: Nobody gets the chair, so an aunty claims it and the room moves on.

all_pass.recap: Everyone finds a decent spot and the room settles.

mixed.recap: Some of you find a spot and the others stand at the back.

all_fail.recap: Nobody can see anything and the room is cranky.

text.default: Someone's phone is the only thing connecting the compound to the match. The commentator says Nigeria are going to penalties, and everyone leans in. {rival} is holding the phone and not sharing.
text.team_2v2: Someone's phone is the only thing connecting the compound to the match. The commentator says Nigeria are going to penalties, and {rival} are holding the phone and not sharing.
text.coop: Someone's phone is the only thing connecting the compound to the match. You and {partner} have to keep it alive and loud enough for everyone.

choices.label: Beg for the phone with a smile
Grab it and hold it up for everyone
Demand that the volume goes up
Switch to a station with a better signal

decisive.recap: {winner} ends up holding the phone and acting as the commentator. {loser} is told to keep quiet.

both_succeed.recap: You both get a share of the phone and the commentary, though {winner} gets the louder side.

both_fail.recap: The signal drops and all you hear is static, until the crowd outside starts shouting.

tie.recap: The phone is passed round and the room agrees to share.

all_pass.recap: The commentary comes through loud and clear.

mixed.recap: Some of the room can hear and the rest rely on gossip.

all_fail.recap: The phone dies and the street goes quiet.

text.default: It is penalties. The compound goes silent, then explodes, then goes silent again. You and {rival} each put a ₦500 bet on the result and the whole room knows it.
text.team_2v2: It is penalties. The compound goes silent, then explodes, then goes silent again. Both households put a ₦500 bet on the result and the whole room knows it.
text.coop: It is penalties. The compound goes silent, then explodes, then goes silent again. You and {partner} have to keep everyone calm while the kicks are taken.

stakes.default: ₦500 each, and a month of bragging rights.

choices.label: Predict the other team will win (reverse psychology)
Raise the bet to ₦1,000
Insult the referee loudly
Stay completely silent so you do not jinx it

decisive.recap: {winner}'s call is right and {loser} owes ₦500. The room claps.

both_succeed.recap: Both predictions land and the room cannot decide who is right, so the bet is doubled.

both_fail.recap: Both predictions are wrong and the bet is cancelled in shame.

tie.recap: The kick hits the post and bounces out. The bet is void.

same.recap: You all said exactly the same thing, so the bet is void and the room boos you for lack of originality.

all_pass.recap: The room's prayers work and the kick goes in.

mixed.recap: Some of the room are praying and some are covering their eyes, and the kick is saved by the keeper.

all_fail.recap: The room's nerves crack and the kick misses.

text.default: At penalty number four, the generator coughs, sputters and dies. Everyone turns to look at you, and {rival} looks very innocent.
text.team_2v2: At penalty number four, the generator coughs, sputters and dies. Everyone turns to look at both households, and {rival} look very innocent.
text.coop: At penalty number four, the generator coughs, sputters and dies. Everyone turns to look at you and {partner}.

stakes.default: Whose fault it is, and who fixes it.
stakes.coop: Getting power back before the last kick.

choices.label: Calm the room while somebody finds fuel
Sprint to the junction with a jerrycan
Blame somebody loudly
Check whether it is fuel or just the plug

decisive.recap: {winner} fixes it in seconds while {loser} is still pointing fingers.

both_succeed.recap: You both help and the lights come back, though {winner} gets the credit.

both_fail.recap: The fuel spills, the plug blows, and the room turns on you all.

tie.recap: The generator restarts on its own and nobody can take credit.

all_pass.recap: You get the generator going just in time for the last kick.

mixed.recap: Some of you fix the plug while the others find the fuel.

all_fail.recap: The generator stays dead and you watch the last kick on someone's phone.

text.default: It is 11 pm and the noise can be heard in the next street. Mama Chidi from downstairs is marching up with a wooden spoon, and {rival} has started pretending to be asleep.
text.team_2v2: It is 11 pm and the noise can be heard in the next street. Mama Chidi from downstairs is marching up with a wooden spoon, and {rival} have started pretending to be asleep.
text.coop: It is 11 pm and the noise can be heard in the next street. Mama Chidi from downstairs is marching up with a wooden spoon, and you and {partner} must handle her.

stakes.default: Who takes the blame for the noise.

choices.label: Offer her a seat and a bottle of Fanta
Slip out of the back door
Argue that this is a national event
Apologise first and promise to lower the volume

decisive.recap: {winner} talks Mama Chidi down. {loser} gets handed the wooden spoon and a lecture.

both_succeed.recap: You both make peace with her, though {winner} gets the extra Fanta.

both_fail.recap: She gets louder than the match did.

tie.recap: She looks at you all, sighs, and goes back downstairs.

all_pass.recap: She leaves with a plate of jollof and a smile.

mixed.recap: Some of you charm her and the others get the lecture.

all_fail.recap: She promises to tell your mothers.

text.default: The match is over. Whatever happened on the pitch, the compound is about to decide who really won the night. You and {rival} each have one last move.
text.team_2v2: The match is over. Whatever happened on the pitch, the compound is about to decide who really won the night. Each pair has one last move.
text.coop: The match is over. You and {partner} have one last move to make the night end well for the compound.

stakes.default: The last word on the night.
stakes.coop: A happy ending for the compound.

choices.label: Celebrate with everyone
Collect on your bet
Argue about the referee until midnight
Go home quietly and sleep

win.default: The compound will talk about tonight for weeks, and your name is in every version. {loser} is still paying off the bet.
win.team_2v2: Your household owned the night. {loser} are still trying to explain the generator.

loss.default: You went home with no bet, no chair and a lecture from Mama Chidi. {winner} will bring it up at every gathering.
loss.team_2v2: Your household went home quiet. {winner} will bring it up at every gathering.

draw.default: The night ends level and the argument goes on until sunrise.

success.default: The compound survived the match, the generator and Mama Chidi, together.

fail.default: The lights, the match and the compound's patience all ran out. Next time, buy fuel earlier.
